parameters.content:
## A. Website enquiry
Check → skip if already saved (same Submission ID) → save lead with qualification → duplicate guard → answer the website ONLY after the save → then acknowledgement email (Email preference), callback task (Phone preference / urgent) and Telegram alert.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://api.airtable.com/v0/appREPLACEWITHBASE/Leads?pageSize=100&fields%5B%5D=Submission%20ID&fields%5B%5D=Enquiry%20Ref&fields%5B%5D=Stage&filterByFormula=' + encodeURIComponent("OR({Submission ID}='" + $('Check Enquiry').first().json.data.submissionId + "', IS_AFTER({Received At}, DATEADD(NOW(), -24, 'hours')))") }}

parameters.content:
## B. Roof photo upload
One photo per call (already shrunk by the browser, ≤3.5 MB). Uploaded straight into the lead's Roof Photos attachment field (Airtable upload limit 5 MB). On a retry, checks the photo is not already there first, so retries never duplicate a photo.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contentType: $('Check Photo').first().json.contentType, filename: $('Check Photo').first().json.filename, file: $('Photo Upload').first().json.body.dataBase64 }) }}

parameters.content:
## C. Customer quote link
The website sends the secret link token; we look the quote up by the token's SHA-256 hash (the token itself is never stored). View = read only. Accept/decline = only if the quote is still the current Sent version and the link has not expired. Accept → lead Won + "Schedule job" task (no job date is promised).

## D. Staff buttons
Airtable button fields open /webhook/roofora/staff?action=…&record=… (password protected). GET shows a confirmation page and changes nothing. POST (the confirm button) does the work:
• book-inspection — checks opening hours + calendar clashes, creates/moves ONE event (fixed event ID per inspection), saves Scheduled, confirms to the customer, then waits for the 24 h and 2 h reminders (each re-checked before sending).
• cancel-inspection / complete-inspection
• send-quote — only Approved quotes; supersedes older versions; secure expiring link
• record-accepted / record-declined — for answers given by phone.

## E. Daily follow-up sweep (once per business morning)
2 Airtable reads per run. For each lead whose follow-up is due it re-checks the CURRENT row (stage, reply, permission, paused, staff takeover) and then: emails (Email preference) or creates a call task (Phone preference). Enquiry: business days 1, 3 · Quote: days 2, 5, 10 (Settings).

## F. Gmail reply detection (ROOFORA mailbox only)
New inbox mail → classify (customer reply / bounce / automatic reply / STOP) → match lead by Gmail thread, then RF- reference, then the single open lead with that address → pause follow-ups, create a task, alert. Automatic replies are logged but do not pause follow-ups. Unmatched mail is ignored (costs no Airtable calls).
